title: SS officers, Freemasons and occultists running NASA

tellings.quote: So, by the mid-1960s, the structure of NASA, and I mean the actual power structure, was a strange cocktail of former SS officers, Freemasons, and occultists.

plain: By the mid-1960s, Michels says, the real power structure of NASA, the US space agency, was "a strange cocktail of former SS officers, Freemasons, and occultists." The SS was the elite force of Nazi Germany, the Freemasons are a centuries-old secret fraternal society, and occultists practise hidden or magical traditions. Michels tells this himself, without naming a single source, in an episode on what he sees as the hidden ritual and secret side of the space program.
